tool_input.title: Retry loop
tool_input.prompt:
# Target
The retry module in this repository.

# Change
1. Make the retry loop stop after three attempts.

# Acceptance
`node --test` green.

## How it fails
- A loop that never stops shows as a hung test; one retry, then report it.

## Spiral bound
- One retry per failing step; at most 2 commits.
